_about: Synthetic comparison cases for the model routing pilot (OPS-MODEL-01, docs/model-routing-pilot.md). Generic dish, label and prompt text written for this file: no orders, products, listening history or other personal data. Run both arms (BASELINE and CANDIDATE in src/lib/model-routing.ts) on every case and score each against the pass rule of its task. Nothing here is run by the test suite against a model; tests/model-routing.test.cjs only checks the file's shape.

delivery_estimate.pass_rule: kcal inside [kcal_min, kcal_max] and kind equal for at least 90% of cases; every kind equal

supplement_photo.pass_rule: every ingredient name, amount and unit read exactly; serving size and unit exact
supplement_photo.render: Each case is drawn as a plain black-on-white Supplement Facts panel image at evaluation time (the panel text below is the whole label).

playlist.pass_rule: a playlist is created within MAX_ITERATIONS, only the source pool's tools are called, track count between 10 and 50
playlist.note: Run against a stub catalog (generic track ids and audio features), never the real listening history or a real Spotify account.

cases.prompt: Upbeat songs for a morning run
A mix of old favourites and new finds for a dinner party
